title: VISIUM TECHNOLOGIES, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Visium Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing internal corporate actions: adoption of Series G Preferred Stock Certificate of Designation (pari passu with Series AA, senior to Series A/B), issuance of 4 shares to accredited investors, and a remediation plan for legacy 2015-2016 Series A/B Preferred Stock with a 125-day voluntary exchange/redemption window. The company notes the probability of Series A/B conversion is remote and excludes those shares from diluted EPS.
key_points: Board approved Series G Certificate of Designation on April 14, 2026, ranking pari passu with Series AA and senior to Series A/B.
Four shares of Series G Preferred Stock issued to existing Series AA holders/affiliates for nominal consideration under Section 4(a)(2) exemption.
Remediation Plan addresses legacy Series A (13,992,340 shares) and Series B (1,327,640 shares) originally issued 2015-2016 with expired statutes of limitations.
125-day voluntary window offers either cash redemption at 25% of stated value ($0.0625/share for Series A; $0.001/share for Series B) or exchange for new unregistered common stock.
Company will pursue declaratory judgment/quiet-title action in Palm Beach County, Florida to confirm validity of remediation plan.
Shares excluded from diluted EPS per ASC 260-10-45-25 and ASC 260-10-45-48; probability of conversion deemed remote.
